title: Molecular Nanotechnology
description: Assemblers that build anything atom by atom - including copies of themselves.

puzzle.goal: Self-replicating assemblers each build a copy of themselves every τ hours, but the feedstock can only support K of them. Write the growth rate of the population N: doubling growth when there are few, slowing to zero as the population fills the capacity.
puzzle.name: Logistic growth of self-replicators
puzzle.ask: The solution is N = K / (1 + (K/N0 − 1)·2^(−t/τ)). Starting from N0 assemblers, find how many exist after time t.
puzzle.method: Pure doubling every τ is exponential growth at rate ln2/τ; multiply by the fraction of capacity still free.
